answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent’s public identity key to an enclave through remote attestation of its MRENCLAVE, the hash of its enclave code and initial state. A copied virtual machine cannot forge the hardware-rooted attestation or extract a protected key; replicating an independently attested agent therefore requires access to physical silicon, not merely VM duplication. The cedar, prism, and kernel components can verify the same measurement and reject identities lacking valid attestation.
